items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: And Leon Washington -- Goon was on tenor sax. And why, we all used to go in there and jam.

ctx.x: I remember when we were in Chicago we used to go out at the Delisa Club. This is the old Mike DeLisa's club. Was on the other side of the street. This is when Albert Ammons had a band. And the guy in there, Guy Kelly was on trumpet in the band, and Albert Ammons and this guy Kelly, and Israel Crosby was on bass. I forgot who was on the drums.
But they had a little band in there. And Leon Washington -- Goon was on tenor sax. And why, we all used to go in there and jam. Every night. And Roy was playing with Fletcher then, Roy Eldridge.
What year would this have been?
